topics.definition: Speech AI enables computers to understand, generate and analyze human speech.
tips: Combine speech processing with NLP for better performance.

topics.definition: A speech signal is the audio waveform produced by human speech.
Sampling rate is the number of audio samples captured per second.
tips: 16 kHz is common for speech tasks.

topics.definition: Feature extraction converts raw audio into informative numerical representations.
A speech pipeline captures, preprocesses, analyzes and produces results from speech.
Speech AI is used in assistants, transcription, call centers and accessibility tools.
tips: Choose models based on latency and accuracy needs.

topics.definition: Noise, accents, overlapping speakers and reverberation make speech processing difficult.
Use quality datasets, robust preprocessing and continuous evaluation.
